links.outcome: Suicidal ideation detection performance of LLM-based versus SDQ-trained ML models on the same data
links.effect: SDQ-trained ML models consistently outperformed LLM-prediction models across all SIQ-JR thresholds. Best SDQ-based model: sensitivity .85, specificity .72. Best LLM-based model: sensitivity .80, specificity .74.
links.quote: Notably, ML models trained directly on SDQ responses consistently outperformed those incorporating LLM predictions across all SIQ-JR thresholds.

screen.reason: The study benchmarks the capability of ML algorithms and off-the-shelf LLMs (Gemini 1.5 Pro, GPT-4o) to predict suicidal ideation from adolescent self-reported survey data, evaluating diagnostic accuracy metrics without testing a specific organizational safeguard or deployment practice.
